name: Blanched or grilled blood cockles
nameVi: Sò huyết luộc làm lông; sò huyết nướng
summary: Sò huyết is grilled, or blanched for two or three minutes in boiling water and turned with chopsticks.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, in the ordinary seafood meal.
howToEat: Grill them, or blanch them làm lông. The blanched plate is two or three minutes in boiling water, turned with chopsticks.
where: The home-style seafood meal in the 9 Jul 2015 account, not a named stall. Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, also lists sò huyết among the live seafood at the market under Núi Bài Thơ.
seoTitle: So huyet in Ha Long — blanched or grilled
seoDescription: Sò huyết in Hạ Long is grilled or blanched for two or three minutes.
